scope: Retain the Axkva Min Nandina and Gorvo encounter while making Nandina's authored 50000-point heal authoritative instead of allowing the post-NGE healing-reduction statistic to rewrite it.

eraEvidence.basis: The expansion encounter is intentionally retained, but Publish 14.1 player progression has no expertise_healing_reduction statistic. The command handler supplies an authored fixed heal amount and the live AI profile supplies its cadence.
findings: heroic_axkva_min.tab spawns Nandina and Gorvo together and respawns both through resetNandina.
heroic_axkva_nandina invokes nandina_heal every ten seconds with full authored AI-profile chance, and the command and combat-data rows route it into combat_actions.java.
nandina_heal resolves the live spawn_id gorvo, refuses an invalid or dead target, heals Gorvo, and plays its retained client effect.
The removed arithmetic was the final Java consumer of expertise_healing_reduction and could reduce the authored 50000-point encounter heal according to an NGE-derived stat on Gorvo.
